data.title: Hop to the Number
data.description: Make each number with your own hops on the number line, then make it a different way.

challenges.instruction: Start at 0 and land on 9 in two hops.
challenges.hint: Pick a hop, look where it lands on the line, then pick the next hop.

challenges.instruction: Start at 0 and land on 10 in two hops.
challenges.hint: Pick a hop, look where it lands on the line, then pick the next hop.

challenges.instruction: Start at 0 and land on 17 in two hops.
challenges.hint: Pick a hop, look where it lands on the line, then pick the next hop.
